issues.description: scan_visible_reviews/7 accumulates with `acc ++ Enum.filter(...)` and calls length(acc) every iteration, quadratic in visible rows held. Bounded by page_size + 1 visible rows (page_size is validated and capped upstream) so it is not a defect; Enum.take plus a counter would be tidier.

Two unrelated pre-existing failures on the branch base (tenant_admin_routes_test AC2 POST /identity/users 500; req077_promotion_pipeline_test:1279 VIEWER plan 500 instead of 403) are not yet filed as issues; TEST-RUNNER/RELEASE-VALIDATOR will see them red. They should be queued so the gate can classify them as known.
